caveat: The top-level range retains unknown outcomes of lost attempts and unsettled corpus labels. Sampling and arm transport have separate ceilings; none upgrades this to a CI.
component_separation: sampling and arm transport are reported beside, not fused into, the top-level partial-identification range

arm_transport.range_kind: historical-to-current arm transport diagnostic; not a confidence interval

directional_not_triple_rated_forced_cont.assumption: every activity with fewer than three successful bulk raters is contested
directional_not_triple_rated_forced_cont.range_kind: directional partition sensitivity; not a confidence interval

missingness_partial_identification.range_kind: partial-identification bounds for unanswered experiment attempts; not a confidence interval

sampling_answered_attempts.coverage_ceiling: 95.0% marginal per fitted rate cell conditional on answered attempts and selected backoff; no simultaneous/headline coverage claim
sampling_answered_attempts.range_kind: sampling sensitivity envelope from marginal Wilson intervals among answered attempts; separate from missingness; not a headline confidence interval

coverage_ceiling: none; deterministic extrema conditional on inputs and mapping
range_kind: partial-identification sensitivity range under missing-attempt extrema and unsettled-label extrema; not a confidence interval

state_snapshot_status.claim_ceiling: hash-bound collection with one explicit nonresponse retained as unsettled; downstream validity gates still apply

third_rater_nonresponses.claim_ceiling: no valid third-rater label after exact-route attempts; per-attempt content outcome and provider-side cause are not established

transition_audit.range_kind: deterministic snapshot transition audit; not a confidence interval

baseline.coverage_ceiling: none; deterministic extrema over unsettled activity labels
baseline.range_kind: unweighted activity-share partial-identification diagnostic; not the employment-weighted headline and not a confidence interval

final.coverage_ceiling: none; deterministic extrema over unsettled activity labels
final.range_kind: unweighted activity-share partial-identification diagnostic; not the employment-weighted headline and not a confidence interval

uncertainty_not_included: transport from the current to the final contested/control partition
